scores.tell: Slightly cool neutral crystal ball; palette (green bg, gold, wood) fits well, minor muted wood.
Loud pink/green/red/blue, saturated like the real cards; pastel cream edges are fine. Very pure hues.
Orange hat on cyan with red band; clean complement and close to the saddle card. Hat is a little monotone.
Gold/purple hues are plausible, but the purple is a bit uniform and the gold highlights are very yellow.
Orange pumpkin on purple with muted wood; glow yellow is believable, floor is a little desaturated.
Many hue families (green, pink, red, blue, terracotta); the scene is busy with no resting neutral, unlike the single-hue-pair real cards.
none; blue gradient with navy body and three small accent lights matches the real cards' spotlight palette.
Red-orange background gradient and orange floor pull the card warm. The pure green chair is the only cool and clashes.
Orange wood with navy, white and gold; warm-heavy but like the real wheel card. Wood chroma is high everywhere.
Lime green background with orange rover and brown dirt; the neon green is louder than real backgrounds and competes with the hero.
